metadata.title: Resumaker — AI-Powered Resume Builder
metadata.description: Create tailored resumes for any job using AI. Full Hebrew support, ATS scoring, and professional templates.

hero.title: Build a Winning Resume with AI
hero.subtitle: Paste a job description — get a tailored, ATS-scored resume in Hebrew or English

ats.description: See exactly how well your resume matches the job description

rtl.description: Native RTL support, optimal typography, formatted for the Israeli market

secure.description: Your data is encrypted, not sold, and never used to train models

tailoring.title: Tailored to Every Job
tailoring.description: Fill in your profile once — every resume is freshly tailored by AI to the specific job description, not just restyled.

commitment.title: Our commitment
commitment.body: Resumaker is committed to making this site usable by everyone, including people with disabilities. We aim to meet WCAG 2.1 Level AA and Israeli accessibility regulations.

standards.title: Standards we follow
standards.body: We test against the following standards:
standards.wcag: WCAG 2.1 Level AA — Web Content Accessibility Guidelines
standards.israeliLaw: Israeli Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities Regulations 5773-2013

features.title: Accessibility features
features.contrast: Color contrast at minimum AA ratio (4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for UI)
features.rtl: Right-to-left support for Hebrew with mirrored layouts
features.focus: Visible focus indicators on all interactive elements
features.screenReader: ARIA labels and semantic HTML throughout

known.title: Known limitations
known.body: Some third-party content (embedded billing portal, payment provider checkout) may not fully meet our standards. We're working with our providers to improve this.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.body: Email our accessibility team if you encounter any barrier or need help using the site.

overview.title: Overview
overview.body: We retain personal data only as long as needed for the service or required by law. The table below reflects what the code actually does.

resumes.duration: Until deleted by you (or 30d after account delete)

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Under GDPR and Israeli Privacy Law you can request access, rectification, restriction, objection, or deletion of your data. Use Settings → Your data, or email privacy@resumaker.co.il.
